Name: (CP) Atmospheric Doors (PIF)
Author: Adarachristine
Description:
[center][b]Atmospheric doors are PIF doors that have a opened door look showing a themed room.[/b][/center]
[center]I tried to make a few doors that represented some PIF rooms created by other authors.
This mod was coded and assets made by me. NO AI
ENJOY!  Im taking door ideas in comments.[/center]


[size=4][b]
Installation
[/b][/size] Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder.
Requires SMAPI,
Content Patcher and [url=PIF mod][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url].
1.6. is required.
